complaint.name: Synthetic Customer 040
complaint.title: [DEMO C040] Sheets lookup fails although the document exists
complaint.description: The customer reports that spreadsheet lookup by display name fails even though the document exists, while accessing it by document ID works.

hypotheses.description: Most likely cause: the observed cedar failure used a display-name identifier on a Google Sheets operation that only accepts spreadsheet_id, so the executor rejected the request on that unsupported path before any provider-side name lookup was needed to explain the 400.
assumptions: Scoped to the observed failed cedar execution req-40 and related tenant metrics, not all customer-reported attempts.
The reproduce evidence is synthetic controlled telemetry, useful for discrimination but not an independent production execution record.
Dependency health shows general provider reachability, not request-level provider participation for req-40.

hypotheses.description: Lower-confidence alternative: the customer may have expected a spreadsheet visible through a different connected account or project boundary, but the supplied canonical telemetry does not show account selection or project identity for req-40.
assumptions: Tenant-localized impact can be compatible with account-selection issues, but is not specific to them.
Even if present, this would be secondary to the observed unsupported identifier-kind failure on req-40.

hypotheses.description: Weakest explanation: provider-side Sheets failure or rate limiting. Current evidence does not show a request-level provider search attempt for req-40, and same-provider health is observed elsewhere at the same time.
assumptions: A narrow provider issue cannot be absolutely excluded from partial telemetry.
General provider reachability is background context, not proof that req-40 reached the provider.

recommended_actions: Synthetic telemetry suggests using the spreadsheet ID for this Sheets operation rather than a display-name lookup path.
Collect the canonical production cedar record for the customer-reported successful direct document-ID request to confirm the exact contrast on the same tenant/connection.
If additional reassurance is needed, retrieve request-level provider-call presence/response telemetry for req-40 rather than inferring provider involvement from dependency health alone.
Verify that the cedar workflow used the intended connected account and project-scoped connection before elevating the account-mismatch alternative.
These are proposed next steps only; they have not been executed in this investigation.
limitations: No canonical production cedar log is supplied for the customer's claimed successful access by document ID; only the failing cedar request is canonical in the incident window.
No canonical records expose connected account identity, project boundary, OAuth scope set, or resource-sharing state for req-40.
The sandbox reproduce records are synthetic controlled observations and do not by themselves prove production behavior.
The provided deployment evidence shows only an unrelated support-dashboard change; it does not independently prove absence of every possible executor-side change.

findings.statement: The canonical cedar request req-40 failed with status 400 while using spreadsheet_identifier "Quarterly Revenue" as identifier_kind=display_name, and the same record states the operation requires spreadsheet_id and name_lookup_supported=false.
For the observed failed execution, the discriminator is the executor log itself: it records an unsupported identifier path, which explains the 400 without needing a provider-side search failure.

Synthetic controlled comparison supports the same mechanism: the original condition using display_name failed with the same spreadsheet_id requirement, while the corrected condition using spreadsheet_id succeeded.

Observed impact was significant but tenant-localized at 10:05: cedar had 385 failures out of 619 requests, all 385 business operations blocked, queue depth 111, and p95 latency 1480 ms, while maple had 0 failures out of 527 requests, queue depth 0, and p95 latency 160 ms.
Counter-evidence against a broad provider outage: dependency telemetry shows provider_api_reachable=true, and another tenant had a same-provider unrelated read succeed at the same timestamp.
There is no canonical production cedar log here for the customer's claimed successful direct-ID access, and no supplied canonical record shows account/project selection for req-40.

[ev_8eaf50f5f88e/sheets-id-040:metrics:0, ev_8eaf50f5f88e/sheets-id-040:metrics:1, ev_5d077567b098/sheets-id-040:logs:1]
